label: Dangerous
definition: Considered extremely high risk. Reactions can be unpredictable and severe. Best avoided entirely.

label: Unsafe
definition: Carries a considerable risk of physical harm. Worth avoiding where you can.

label: Caution
definition: Not usually physically harmful, but effects can be uncomfortable or hard to predict. Care and a lower dose help.

label: Low risk & decrease
definition: Effects tend to subtract from each other. Unlikely to add risk beyond what each carries alone.

label: Low risk & no synergy
definition: Effects tend to add together. Unlikely to add risk beyond what each carries alone.

label: Low risk & synergy
definition: Effects tend to amplify each other. Low risk when approached carefully; reading up first is worthwhile.

label: Unknown
definition: Not enough reliable information to say. Worth treating as unpredictable.
